tagline: Leading provider of title insurance and real estate solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of the company's overall performance, reflecting its ability to generate sales across its business segments (title and real estate solutions).

kpis.name: Total Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by all of the company's activities.
kpis.description: Increase in total revenue compared to the prior year, indicating business expansion.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Indicates profitability of operations before considering other expenses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin (before taxes)
kpis.explanation: Pre-tax operating income divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Measures profitability of the company's core operations before taxes.

kpis.name: Title Segment Operating Revenue
kpis.description: Performance of the company's primary segment, title services.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in the title segment.

kpis.short: Real Estate Solutions Segment Operating Revenues
kpis.name: Real Estate Solutions Segment Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by real estate-related services.
kpis.description: Performance of the segment providing services to real estate professionals, including MCS from Q4 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in real estate solutions.

kpis.name: Total Rent Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total cost of rent for offices and facilities.
kpis.description: Indicates expenses incurred for 440+ leased locations across the United States and the United Kingdom.

kpis.name: Total Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Sum of all expenses incurred by the company.
kpis.description: Represents the total cost of the company's operations (2860M revenue - 165.6M pretax income = approximately 2694.4M expenses).
kpis.signal: Expense growth in line with revenue growth.

kpis.name: Title Segment Pretax Margin
kpis.explanation: Pretax margin of the title segment relative to its revenues.
kpis.description: Profitability of the title segment before taxes (annual calculation, Q4 was 8.5%).
kpis.signal: Steady improvement in title segment margin.

kpis.short: Real Estate Solutions Segment Pretax Margin
kpis.name: Real Estate Solutions Segment Pretax Margin
kpis.explanation: Pretax margin of the real estate solutions segment relative to its revenues.
kpis.description: Profitability of the real estate solutions segment before taxes; Q4 2025 was 3.5%, Q4 2024 was 1.1%.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in real estate solutions segment margin.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Mortgage Contracting Services (MCS)
kpis.explanation: Integration of MCS to expand the base of mortgage servicing clients and lender services.
kpis.description: Major acquisition of MCS (Q4 2025), a leader in property preservation and field services for mortgage servicers. Integrated into the real estate solutions segment.

kpis.name: Domestic Commercial Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from closed commercial transactions in the United States.
kpis.description: Increase in commercial revenue for full-year 2025, driven by data center, energy assets, retail, and mixed-use transactions.

kpis.short: Average Domestic Commercial Fee Per File
kpis.name: Average Domestic Commercial Fee Per File
kpis.explanation: Average fee charged for closed commercial transactions in the United States.
kpis.description: Average cost per commercial transaction increased significantly in Q4 2025 ($27,300 vs $19,600 in Q4 2024), reflecting larger transactions.
kpis.signal: Increase in average price of commercial transactions.

risks.title: Title Policy Loss Risk
risks.score_rationale: Title loss provisions at 3.4% of title operating revenues in 2025, with risk of uncertainty in estimating future reserves and significant claims

risks.title: Independent Agency Defalcations
risks.score_rationale: Risk of fund misappropriation by independent agencies, significant exposures in trust accounts; large claims managed separately

risks.title: Real Estate Market Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Sensitivity to interest rates, mortgage transaction volumes, property prices, and conditions in residential and commercial real estate markets

risks.title: Regulatory Changes
risks.score_rationale: Potential regulatory changes in title insurance and real estate services; moderate impact on current operations

risks.title: Competitive Pressure
risks.score_rationale: Competition for title market share and real estate services; ability to attract and retain productive employees

ai_positioning.summary: The company STC has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing.
